slots.notes: Fullscreen looping hero background video. Rendered as <video autoPlay loop muted playsInline> with absolute inset-0, w/h-full, object-cover, sitting at z-0 behind all foreground content on a pure-black (#000000) h-screen section. Cover-cropped so it fills any viewport. Foreground is white-on-dark (giant headline, nav pill, two body paragraphs, CTA) layered above at relative z-10, so pick calm/dark footage that reads well under white overlay text across the whole frame. Currently a CloudFront placeholder mp4.

Brand logo mark in the left of the navbar, beside the 'DesignPro' wordmark. Spec describes a circular badge: a 2px white-bordered outer circle containing a smaller filled white solid circle (concentric dot-in-ring). Rendered small (nav-height, ~h-8/w-8). Built from divs/borders or inline SVG with white stroke + white fill baked to the white-on-black scheme; supply the brand mark as a single-color, fill/stroke-inheriting (currentColor) glyph so it stays tintable rather than hard-coding the hex.

Directional arrow icon (ArrowRight) from lucide-react, rendered inside the 'Apply for Next Enrollment' CTA button (and a second arrow on the 'Contact us' nav link). Inherits currentColor (white) and sits at button text size. On group-hover it translate-x's to the right via a smooth CSS transition. Swap for the brand's arrow/chevron glyph; keep it a single-color line icon that inherits currentColor.

Single global UI typeface. Spec specifies Inter (sans-serif) applied to the whole hero. Drives everything: the giant two-line headline ('Become' / 'Product Leader.') at text-5xl scaling to text-9xl with line-height 0.85 and tracking-tighter, the small uppercase eyebrow, nav links (text-sm), the CTA label, the wordmark, and both body paragraphs (text-sm/text-base). Swap with the brand display sans; the headline layout (0.85 line-height, tracking-tighter, 9xl scale) is tuned to Inter's metrics.

mechanic: A single full-viewport (h-screen) black hero layering an autoplaying object-cover looping background video (z-0) beneath a relative z-10 stack: a rounded-pill navbar with a dot-in-ring logo, a two-column intro paragraph row, and a centered eyebrow + giant two-line headline whose second line ('Product Leader.') is a framer-motion ShinyText that continuously sweeps a 100deg #64CEFB→#ffffff gradient left-to-right across background-clip:text on a 3s loop, closing with a rounded-full CTA whose lucide arrow translate-x's on group-hover.
techDelivery: React + TypeScript + Vite + Tailwind CSS (mobile-first sm/md/lg/xl breakpoints, utility classes only); framer-motion drives the ShinyText gradient-sweep animation and lucide-react supplies the arrow icons; Inter loaded as the global sans; includes a custom ShinyText component implementing the background-clip:text transparent-fill gradient sweep.
reskinNotes: The ShinyText animation bakes two hex literals into the component as the gradient stops — base color #64CEFB and shine #ffffff (plus a hard-coded 3s speed and 100deg spread) — so retinting the headline shine means editing the component props/CSS gradient, not a token. The logo is a CSS/SVG dot-in-ring built from white border + white fill in markup rather than a swappable asset file. All copy is hard-coded in the JSX: the 'DesignPro' wordmark, the seven nav labels (Home, About Us, Courses, Instructors, Testimonials, Blog, Contact us), the 'Seats for Next Program Opening Soon' eyebrow, both intro paragraphs (the transformative-programs sentence and '8000+ Talented Designers Launched !'), the two headline words, and the 'Apply for Next Enrollment' CTA. The palette is expressed via Tailwind opacity utilities (white/80, gray-700 border, black/gray-900 button) rather than CSS custom properties, so there is no single token block to retheme. The headline is viewport-scaled (text-5xl→text-9xl, line-height 0.85, tracking-tighter) and tuned to the specific two-word copy and Inter's metrics, so longer headline copy or a wider typeface will reflow the centered layout.
